info.title: malac-hd
info.description: MaLaC-HD, the Mapping Language Compiler for Health Data, as a .NET tool: compiles FHIR mappings (FML, StructureMaps, ConceptMaps) to Python, JavaScript, Java or C#. Runs the malac-hd Python package, which needs Python 3.10 or later.

options.name: --help
options.description: show this help message and exit

options.name: --mapping
options.description: the mapping file path, the conversion/mapping rule language is detected by file ending, right now FML maps (*.map), FHIR R4 (*.4.fhir.xml) StructureMaps and ConceptMaps can be given as mappings

options.name: --convert_output
options.description:
the conversion output file path (a .py, .js, .java or .cs file, depending on --language), if not given, saved in the working directory with the map-file name.
A Java or C# class is named like its file, so the name of a .java or .cs file has to be one such a class can have
(and no reserved word)

options.name: --language
options.description:
the language the mapping is compiled to (default: python). JavaScript code needs the malac-utils JS runtime
(`require('malac-utils')`) and, for a direct TRANSFORMATION, Node.js; it reads and writes JSON only,
except for a source model without a JSON form (CDA), which it reads as XML. Java code needs the Java side of
malac-utils and the Java models of malac-models (their jars, see their README.md) and, for a direct TRANSFORMATION,
a JDK (javac and java). C# code needs the .NET side of malac-utils and the .NET models of malac-models (their
assemblies, see their README.md) and, for a direct TRANSFORMATION, a .NET SDK (dotnet)

options.name: --js_utils
options.description:
with --language javascript: also write the malac-utils JS runtime the mapping needs, i.e. the self-contained
malac-utils.js of the installed malac-utils package, which works in a web browser as well as with Node.js.
Without a path it is written as malac-utils.js next to the conversion output (-co), or into the working directory

options.name: --transform_input
options.description: the transformation input file path, the ressource type is detected by its root node inside the xml

options.name: --transform_output
options.description: the transformation output file path, the ressource type is detected by its root node inside the xml

options.name: --models
options.description: register additional model packages: importable module names or paths to Python files, each exposing a list_i_o_modules dict (see malac.hd.load_model_packages); the MALAC_HD_MODELS environment variable is read as well

options.name: --supporting-resource
options.description: additional FHIR resources that support the mapping (currently ConceptMaps), resolved by canonical URL when translate() references a map not defined inline. Each value is a directory of JSON/XML resources, an npm package .tgz, or a single .json/.xml file. If not given, the MALAC_HD_SUPPORTING_RESOURCES environment variable is used instead

options.name: --silent
options.description: do not print the converted mapping to console
